text:
samira: quick flag - support noticed tenants seeing v2 badge but billing shows v1 tokens later. feels like our pre-route fast-path is winning dashboard attribution. anyone want to brainstorm mitigation heuristics?

raj: i've got a candidate: compute an attribution_confidence score per req. priority: exec.resolved_model (1.0), router.decision (0.85), billing.billed_model (0.7), header.client_version (0.3). use confidence to filter chart slices < 0.6.

oliver: i like the score. couple followups: 1) how do we compute for streaming requests where exec.finish may not exist? 2) memory cost for join window if we wait for router/executor events?

samira: for streaming we can fallback to incremental confidence: if first N tokens executed on model X, attribute those tokens to X with confidence based on N/expected_total. rough but better than header-only.

helen: join window calc: if we use a 10s window keyed by req_id, worst-case peak at 75k rps => mem high. alternate: only buffer for tenants in "cohort-shadow" and sample 1% globally. full join only for reconciliation jobs (batch).

raj: agreed. upstream goal: don't change realtime billing pipeline immediately. implement confidence in console first as a heuristic overlay. then run shadow matching for 48h on full traffic and collect per-tenant delta stats.

oliver: shadow plan: emit both attributes in events: attributed_model (nullable) + attribution_confidence. downstream consumers prefer attributed_model when confidence >= 0.8. record both for audit.

helen: reconciliation policy decision needed: silent-correct if pct_delta < 0.4% OR est_delta_dollars < $20. legal okayed threshold for automated correction. above that, surface as "reissue preview" to revenue-ops and tenant owners.

samira: UX: add a small badge on version pie: "confident data only" toggle. default left as current behavior to avoid surprises. add tooltip: "Confidence is a heuristic combining routing+exec events; low-confidence counts may be recalculated."

raj: monitoring: alert if matching_rate (header_vs_resolved) > 2% for 30m or if join_buffer_p99 > 12s during shadow. also create a dashboard for top 50 tenants by pct_delta.

billing-bot: created TASK-BILL-411 "attr-confidence-shadow-and-reconcile" assigned to samira, raj. ETA: 72h. (https://redwood.internal/tasks/TASK-BILL-411)

oliver: action items: 1) samira - prototype console confidence overlay + badge copy 2) raj - event schema changes to include attributed_model+confidence (nullable) + shadow flag 3) helen - draft reconciliation runbook and threshold list 4) i'll schedule perf sim for join window sampling.

samira: will open PR for UI copy and feature flag. aim to flip shadow on for 5% sample tomorrow. will post PR link here. :sparkles:
